title: 第15章 变成执事第16章 虚荣怪
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
穆无双一脸愕然，她没想到居然还会发生这种事情，她双手一摊道：“那我有什么办法！”
“我家老二修炼本来就比别人用的灵石多，他又不去战场，又不做任务，一天就知道喝酒。”
“好不容易找到一个利人利己的赚钱方式，又没给我惹祸，我高兴还来不及呢！”
林青河道：“这剑符你不能让他继续卖了，这样下去，以后谁还会辛苦修炼？”
穆无双一副摆烂姿态道：“那你们自己跟他说，我是不说。”
“但如果他不愿意，那就算了，谁敢逼他，就先跟我打一场。”
她凌厉的眼神中充满了霸气，令众人都不敢直视。
二长老等人在宗门最忌惮的并不是宗主，而是这个杀伐果断的小师妹。
因为宗主还会遵守规则，顾全大局，但这小师妹发起疯来是完全不讲规则的，而且她实力又那么强，简直无解！
秦峰小院
柳梦瑶吃了一口烤肉，竖起一个大拇指道：“二师兄，你的手艺真好，好好吃啊！”
秦峰道：“那就多吃点。”
他自己也咬了一口，味道很不错，虽然少了一些佐料，但这灵兽肉天然的味道更加美味。
再喝一口百年的梨花醉，美滋滋啊！
正在这时一名弟子敲开院门道：“秦峰师兄，掌门跟长老们让你去主殿一趟！”
秦峰眉头一皱，这帮老家伙找自己准没好事，但他绞尽脑汁，也想不出有什么事。
自己这两天都在拼命冲击筑基，也没出去啊！
柳梦瑶担忧道：“师兄，发生了什么事？”
秦峰摇了摇头：“我也不太清楚，我去看看，你先吃着。”
跟着这弟子来到了主殿，那众人都向这边看来。

师父也在场，看师父的表情没有任何异样，秦峰也安心了，这些年他早就练出了察言观色的本领。
师父这个人是藏不住事儿的，师父表情淡然，就说明没事。
林青河笑呵呵道：“秦峰，经过我们几个长老商议，打算给你安排一个好差事。”
“现在任务殿，灵药园，灵兽园，你随便选。
奖励丰厚。”
穆无双道：“他们不想让你卖剑符了，因为外门弟子用剑符打败内门弟子，让他们没有面子。”
其余人都怒目圆瞪的看着穆无双，他们本来想让秦峰接受这个差事。
他自然就没有时间去画符了，也保全了他们的颜面，让一帮老家伙求一个晚辈，属实拉不下脸。
没想到老七居然不讲武德，这个宠徒狂魔直接揭穿，一点面子也不给他们。
看着众人杀人的目光，穆无双无所谓道：“我就不喜欢你们这么虚伪的人，说话拐弯抹角的。”
“有话直说不好吗？”
秦峰知道了对方的意图，有些为难道：“我哪都不想去，我最不喜欢做任务了！”
“内门弟子觉得没有面子，可以让他们也来我这里买符啊，可以给他们优惠点！”
几名长老顿时气的脸色铁青，如果以后大家都使用剑符，那还修炼个屁。
但看到穆无双那凶神恶煞的样子，众人也不敢勉强。
content_en:
Mu Wushuang looked stunned. She didn't expect that such a thing would happen. She spread her hands and said, "Then what can I do!"
"My second child uses more spiritual stones to practice than others. He doesn't go to the battlefield or do tasks. He only drinks alcohol every day."
"I finally found a way to make money that benefits others and myself without causing trouble for me. It's too late for me to be happy!"
Lin Qinghe said: "You can't let him continue to sell this sword talisman. If this continues, who will work hard to practice in the future?"
Mu Wushuang said with a bad attitude: "Then you tell him yourself, I won't tell you."
"But if he doesn't want to, forget it. Whoever dares to force him should have a fight with me first."
Her sharp eyes were full of domineering power, making everyone afraid to look directly at her.
What the Second Elder and others fear most in the sect is not the sect leader, but this young junior sister who is decisive in killing.
Because the sect leader will still abide by the rules and take care of the overall situation, but this little junior sister goes crazy without following the rules at all, and she is so strong, there is no solution!
Qinfeng courtyard
Liu Mengyao took a bite of the barbecue, gave a thumbs up and said: "Second Senior Brother, your cooking is so good, it's delicious!"
Qin Feng said: "Then eat more."
He took a bite himself and it tasted very good. Although some condiments were missing, the natural taste of the spirit beast meat was even more delicious.
Take another sip of century-old pear blossom wine, it’s so delicious!
At this moment, a disciple knocked on the courtyard door and said, "Senior Brother Qin Feng, the master and the elders want you to go to the main hall!"
Qin Feng frowned. These old guys were definitely looking for something wrong with him, but he racked his brains and couldn't think of anything.
I have been working hard to build the foundation for the past two days, but I haven't gone out yet!
Liu Mengyao said worriedly: "Brother, what happened?"
Qin Feng shook his head: "I'm not sure either. I'll go take a look. You eat first."
Following this disciple to the main hall, everyone looked this way.
The master was also present. Seeing that there was nothing strange about his expression, Qin Feng felt relieved. Over the years, he had already developed the ability to observe words and emotions.
Master can't hide things. Master's expression is calm, which means everything is fine.
Lin Qinghe said with a smile: "Qin Feng, after discussion among several of our elders, we plan to arrange a good job for you."
"Now the mission hall, the spiritual medicine garden, the spiritual beast garden, you can choose whatever you want.
The rewards are huge. "
Mu Wushuang said: "They don't want you to sell sword talismans, because the outer disciples use sword talismans to defeat the inner disciples, which makes them lose face."
The rest of the people looked at Mu Wushuang angrily. They originally wanted Qin Feng to accept this job.
Naturally, he didn't have time to draw the talisman, and he also saved their face. It was really embarrassing to let a bunch of old guys beg a junior.
Unexpectedly, Lao Qi didn't respect martial ethics. This maniac who loved his disciple directly exposed it without giving them any face.
Looking at the murderous looks of everyone, Mu Wushuang said indifferently: "I don't like hypocritical people like you who talk in a roundabout way."
"Isn't it better to just say what you have to say?"
Qin Feng knew the other party's intention and felt a little embarrassed: "I don't want to go anywhere, I don't like doing tasks the most!"
"If the inner disciples feel that they are losing face, I can ask them to buy talismans from me. I can give them a discount!"
Several elders suddenly turned livid with anger. If everyone uses sword talismans in the future, it will be a waste of practice.
But seeing Mu Wushuang's fierce look, no one dared to force it.
